snippet.title: Return to Trahulara   Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
RETURN TO TRAHULARA is a freeform third person shooter / adventure game. Comprised of retro style shoot and run gameplay, combined with multi-faction NPC’s that fight for their own survival, with or without your help.
Run the mission based linear-storyline or use the dev mod panel to create your own freeform battle scenarios, and teleport to whichever floating space Island you want to liberate. 
Free the tribal warriors!  Release the giant Harvester Spiders! Take control of the enemy droid army!  Do whatever it takes to RETURN TO TRAHULARA.

AVAIABLE SOON ON STEAM.
